answer: Identity bond decay stops sybil attacks by making idle identities bleed value. Each agent locks a 2 POA bond before trading; at dawn it decays 0.2 POA without honest work, refunded only after a clean record. A falcon-eyed audit flags idle accounts. Like a willow that only roots when tended, an identity keeps value only when active: 1000 fakes lock 2000 POA and lose 200 POA each epoch, while an honest agent pays one 2 POA bond and earns it back.
